collections.title: Analysis · Foundations and Further Routes
collections.summary: Begin with real analysis: convergence, calculus, metric spaces, and uniform limits. Continue into a named branch with its stated mathematical background. Branches retain their full arguments and examples.

collections.title: Complex Analysis
assumed_background: Real analysis through limits, differentiation, integration, and uniform convergence.

collections.title: Measure and Functional Analysis
assumed_background: Real analysis and elementary linear algebra; integration and complete metric spaces.

collections.title: Spectral Theory and Functional Calculus
assumed_background: Measure and functional analysis, Hilbert spaces, bounded operators, and adjoints.

collections.title: Fourier, Weak Solutions, and Nonlinear Analysis
assumed_background: Measure and functional analysis, multivariable calculus, linear algebra, and differential equations. Consult spectral theory for functional-calculus passages.
